school.jaymoskingdoms.welcome.0: %1$s, is it? Stand there, not too straight. Welcome to %2$s.
school.jaymoskingdoms.welcome.1: Another pair of hands for %2$s. Good, %1$s. Read the book slowly, then forget half of it.
school.jaymoskingdoms.welcome.2: You'll do, %1$s. %2$s keeps those who keep at it.
school.jaymoskingdoms.one_house.0: One house at a time, %s. Finish what you began before you begin another.
school.jaymoskingdoms.one_house.1: You belong to another door already, %s. Come back when it's shut behind you.
school.jaymoskingdoms.one_house.2: Not yet, %s. A second house wants a first one finished.
school.jaymoskingdoms.taught.0: Watch my feet, %1$s, then do it badly. %2$s: that's yours now.
school.jaymoskingdoms.taught.1: %2$s, %1$s. It comes from the hips, not the arm.
school.jaymoskingdoms.taught.2: Here is %2$s. Don't show it off; use it.
school.jaymoskingdoms.wait.0: Not yet, %s. The next lesson comes when the last is worn smooth.
school.jaymoskingdoms.wait.2: You rush, %s. Go and swing at something that swings back.
school.jaymoskingdoms.onward.0: You're coming along, %s. There's a last thing, but it's a way off.
school.jaymoskingdoms.onward.2: The door's closer than it was, %s. Don't look at it.
school.jaymoskingdoms.master.0: That's all of it, %1$s. The last of %2$s was never a lesson. It was always yours.
school.jaymoskingdoms.master.1: Hm. %1$s, you've worn the floor through. Take what's left of %2$s.
school.jaymoskingdoms.master.2: Enough. %2$s has nothing more to keep from you, %1$s.
school.jaymoskingdoms.after.0: You know the way out, %s. Come back and find me quiet.
school.jaymoskingdoms.after.1: I've nothing left to teach you, %s. Stay for tea.
school.jaymoskingdoms.blade.welcome.0: The Quiet Tide never hurries, and never stops.
school.jaymoskingdoms.blade.welcome.2: Listen to the water before you listen to me.
school.jaymoskingdoms.blade.mastery.0: The ninth cut is eight, said all at once.
school.jaymoskingdoms.blade.mastery.1: You've said it. Now keep quiet about it.
school.jaymoskingdoms.blade.mastery.2: Take the lacquer. It's only a face; you still have to wear the rest.
school.jaymoskingdoms.spear.welcome.0: Reach is only patience with a long handle.
school.jaymoskingdoms.spear.welcome.1: Mind where your feet stand. Ground is a loan.
school.jaymoskingdoms.spear.welcome.2: Lean on the wind. It holds more than you'd think.
school.jaymoskingdoms.spear.mastery.0: A point goes where the eye has already been.
school.jaymoskingdoms.spear.mastery.1: Some of us came down, some stayed up. You'll do for either.
school.jaymoskingdoms.spear.mastery.2: Take the mask. It has more feathers than sense.
school.jaymoskingdoms.fist.welcome.1: Hands first. Everything else is an excuse.
school.jaymoskingdoms.fist.mastery.0: Stone doesn't boast. Neither should you.
school.jaymoskingdoms.fist.mastery.1: You've a root now. Don't pull it up.
school.jaymoskingdoms.fist.mastery.2: Hands never leave you at the door. Take the mask regardless.
school.jaymoskingdoms.knife.welcome.1: A man looks where the light points.
school.jaymoskingdoms.knife.mastery.0: The quarry named you first, you know.
school.jaymoskingdoms.knife.mastery.1: Light's low. Good. Take the veil.
school.jaymoskingdoms.knife.mastery.2: Leave a cloak behind when you go.
school.jaymoskingdoms.claw.welcome.0: Where we learned it, the sky was stone.
school.jaymoskingdoms.claw.welcome.1: A hand with edges needs no apology.
school.jaymoskingdoms.claw.welcome.2: Spring from the shoulder, not the leg.
school.jaymoskingdoms.claw.mastery.0: You've the deep places in you now.
school.jaymoskingdoms.claw.mastery.1: We kept the door in mind. Take the mask.
